comparison.objective: Continuously meter a hydraulic release valve to lower a fragile cabinet safely; the candidate instead sets and locks damping between discrete test cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Feedback-controlled fine valve rotation during load motion overlaps rotary regulation, but lacks hex-key unlocking, retained-collar adjustment, and post-setting relock.
comparison.success_condition: Gentle rail landing, no glass contact, full load transfer, and hands-off support for 3 seconds; the demonstrated landing was 13.34 mm/s, but the body omits the scoring limit and spec versions.
comparison.reason: The record tests active load lowering, whereas the candidate tests iterative commissioning and retention of a passive impact absorber.
